quests.title: The Time Traveler Historian Adventure
quests.description: Travel through time to explore ancient civilizations and uncover the secrets of history!

story.introduction: Professor Chronos has invented an amazing time machine! Join him on incredible journeys to ancient civilizations and discover how people lived thousands of years ago.

steps.title: Expedition to the Indus Valley
steps.narrative: Your first time travel destination: the amazing Indus Valley Civilization! Explore the well-planned cities of Harappa and Mohenjo-daro.

problem.question: What made the Indus Valley cities like Harappa special?
options: They had excellent drainage and street planning
problem.correct_answer: They had excellent drainage and street planning
problem.explanation: Amazing discovery! The Indus Valley people were master city planners. They built straight streets, proper drainage systems, and even public baths!

steps.title: Ancient Egypt Pyramid Quest
steps.narrative: Travel to ancient Egypt and help the pharaohs build their magnificent pyramids! Learn about this incredible civilization.

problem.question: Why did ancient Egyptians build pyramids?
problem.explanation: Correct! Pyramids were magnificent tombs for pharaohs (Egyptian kings). They believed pharaohs would need their treasures in the afterlife!

steps.title: Mesopotamia Invention Laboratory
steps.narrative: Visit ancient Mesopotamia, the 'cradle of civilization'! Discover the amazing inventions that changed the world forever.

problem.question: What important invention did the people of Mesopotamia give to the world?
problem.explanation: Fantastic! The wheel was one of humanity's greatest inventions! It revolutionized transportation and is still essential today.

steps.title: Become the Civilization Time Master
steps.narrative: The ultimate time travel challenge! The Time Guardian tests your knowledge of all ancient civilizations. Prove you're worthy of the Time Master title!

problem.question: Which ancient civilization is known for creating the first writing system?
problem.explanation: Brilliant! The Sumerians in Mesopotamia created cuneiform, the world's first writing system. This allowed humans to record history and knowledge!

quests.title: The Geography Explorer Quest
quests.description: Become a world explorer and discover the amazing features of our planet Earth!

story.introduction: Captain Globe needs brave explorers to map the world! Join the Geography Explorer Team and discover continents, oceans, mountains, and rivers!

steps.title: The Great Continent Discovery
steps.narrative: Your first mission: identify all seven continents! Captain Globe's magic globe will test your knowledge.

problem.question: Which is the largest continent in the world?
problem.explanation: Excellent! Asia is the largest continent, home to countries like India, China, and Russia. It covers about 30% of Earth's land!

steps.title: Ocean Adventure Voyage
steps.narrative: Dive into the ocean adventure! Explore the five mighty oceans that cover most of our blue planet.

problem.question: Which ocean surrounds India on three sides?
problem.explanation: Perfect! The Indian Ocean surrounds India on the south, southwest, and southeast. It's named after our beautiful country!

steps.title: Mountain Climbing Challenge
steps.narrative: Scale the highest peaks and learn about Earth's magnificent mountain ranges! Each mountain has its own story.

problem.question: Which mountain range contains Mount Everest, the world's highest peak?
problem.explanation: Amazing! The Himalayas contain Mount Everest. These mountains are like Earth's crown, and they're right here in our region!

steps.title: Defeat the Climate Weather Wizard
steps.narrative: The Weather Wizard has mixed up all the seasons and climates! Use your geography knowledge to restore natural order to the world!

problem.question: Why does India have different seasons throughout the year?
options: Earth moves closer and farther from the sun
Earth tilts as it orbits the sun
The sun gets hotter and cooler
problem.correct_answer: Earth tilts as it orbits the sun
problem.explanation: Brilliant! Earth tilts on its axis as it orbits the sun. This tilt causes different parts to get more or less sunlight, creating our seasons!

quests.title: The Indian Heritage Journey
quests.description: Discover the rich cultural heritage of India through festivals, traditions, and values!

story.introduction: Welcome to the Indian Heritage Museum! Curator Bharati will take you on a colorful journey through India's festivals, languages, arts, and traditions.

steps.title: Festival Celebration Hall
steps.narrative: Enter the Festival Hall where every day is a celebration! Learn about India's colorful festivals and their meanings.

problem.question: Which festival is known as the 'Festival of Lights'?
problem.explanation: Wonderful! Diwali is the Festival of Lights when we light diyas and celebrate the victory of light over darkness, good over evil!

steps.title: Language Diversity Garden
steps.narrative: Walk through the Language Garden where every flower represents a different Indian language! Appreciate our linguistic diversity.

problem.question: How many official languages does India have?
problem.explanation: Excellent! India has 22 official languages! This shows how diverse and rich our country is. Unity in diversity is our strength!

steps.title: Traditional Art and Craft Workshop
steps.narrative: Visit the workshop where master artisans create beautiful traditional crafts. Learn about India's artistic heritage!

problem.question: Which traditional Indian art form uses colored sand to create beautiful patterns?
problem.explanation: Perfect! Rangoli is made with colored sand, rice, or flower petals. It's created during festivals to welcome guests and bring good luck!
